chamada: Scheduled "Ask…": the invited person answers in text, in the order the questions arrived. Nobody votes on questions.

agenda.vazioProximas: No session scheduled in the next 14 days.
agenda.aceito: Invitation accepted. The session shows up for whoever can see the question box.
agenda.comoMarcar: To schedule a session, open your question box on your profile, or the one of the community you moderate.

sessao.regra: Questions come in the order they arrive and are answered in that order. Nobody votes to jump the queue.
sessao.quemPerguntou: Who asked only shows if they wanted. One day after the end, Alumia forgets who asked each question.
sessao.aguarde: The session starts {quando}. You can already send a question.
sessao.encerrada: This session is over. The answers stay here.
sessao.cancelarConfirmar: Cancel the session? Its questions go away too.

perguntar.mostrarNome: Show my alias with the question

fila.titulo: The questions, in order of arrival

responder.explica: You answer or pass the first question in the queue. The next one shows up right after.
responder.antes: You answer from the start of the session.
responder.nada: The queue is empty. When a question arrives, it shows up here.

caixa.convidadaRotulo: Who answers (the @ of the person you invite)
caixa.convidadaAjuda: The person gets an invitation and the session only shows up after they accept.
caixa.convidada: Invitation sent. The session shows up when the person accepts.
caixa.limite: Up to {n} upcoming sessions per box.

erros.consentimento: Only people on Alumia can do this.
erros.travado: This session no longer takes questions.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove the personal data (phone, email, ID or address) and send again.
erros.muitos_pedidos: You already have the maximum waiting. Wait for an answer before sending another.
erros.fora_da_vez: This is not the question up now. The screen was refreshed.
erros.alumia_entrada: This opens after your entry to Alumia is approved.
erros.desligado: Live sessions are turned off right now.
